tools.name: check_public_pdf
tools.title: Check a public PDF
tools.description: Downloads one PDF from a public http or https link and reports the structure that screen readers use: whether the file is tagged, whether it has a document title and a language, how many images have no text description and on which pages, and reading-order signals (pages with columns are flagged for a person to check). Also reports the page count and which pages look scanned or contain tables. Use when the user gives a link to a PDF on a public website and asks about its accessibility or screen-reader structure. Does not open files behind a login, does not change the file, and does not say whether the file meets PDF/UA, WCAG or any law.

url.description: Link to one PDF on a public website: http or https, at most 2,048 characters.

detail.description: When true, adds the page-by-page list.

tools.name: quote_fix
tools.title: Estimate the price to make public PDFs accessible
tools.description: For one to five links to PDFs on public websites, checks whether each file qualifies and returns a price estimate from CyberNative AI LLC's published Terms for the same PDF with tags added: USD 4 per page, minimum USD 100 per order. Names each file that does not qualify, such as a scanned file, a fillable form, a map or drawing, or a file over 35 pages, with the reason, and does not price it. The estimate is not binding and nothing is ordered by calling this tool; the price is confirmed by email before any work. Use when the user asks what it would cost to have these PDFs made accessible.

urls.description: One to five links to PDFs on public websites: http or https, at most 2,048 characters each.

detail.description: When true, adds the page-by-page price for each file that qualifies.

annotations.title: Estimate the price to make public PDFs accessible
